Hi

That is an unusual way to identify a model, but the following specification would do it:

x1~~1*x1

Mikko

On 6 Feb 2018, at 18:46 , Dimitrios Zacharatos <sedz...@gmail.com> wrote:

I am trying to define a simple CFA model in which the uniqueness (error) of a couple of items has to be set to 1 for identification.
How can I declare that in the model?

lavaanmodel<-'f1=~x1+x2+x3
                         f2=~x3+x4+x5
# I have to write something here to define uniqueness to one
                                '
